title: Kirstin’s path
description: After beginning her career as an interior designer, Kirstin Turner decided to become a financial advisor, which was a more fulfilling path for her. Soon after, her manager recognized her leadership potential, and Kirstin now leads RBC Wealth Management’s Florida complex.

asr.full_text: Kiersten Turner My name is Kirsten Turner, and I am the Florida Complex Director for RBC Wealth Management. I was a stubborn kid. Pretty competitive, and I just really loved sailing. I loved the competitiveness. I loved the strategy, and you're now looking back on it, a lot of what we do in our job as Financial Advisors or Complex Directors, it's all strategy, and figuring out how to get our clients from where they are now to where they want to be. I went to Florida State University to study commercial interior design. I had a great experience but I don't think I was ever really truly fulfilled and I really stumbled upon becoming a financial advisor. I started reading some books about it and the idea of what financial advisors did and how they affected people's lives. And I started to get really excited about it and it was just sort of this mission that took off on its own. So I was 27 years old when I became a Financial Advisor and I had finally built up a nice book of business. One of my managers came to me and said, have you ever thought about Branch Management? So I went into the Management Training Program. It was the best decision I think that I've probably ever made. Life is not a dress rehearsal. You've only got one chance at doing this. And so you might as well get up every day and be the best you can be and do the best and most you can for you and yourself and your family and your community. I love what I do more than anything else. 🎵

The speaker discusses her career development and management training rather than offering investment returns, requesting money or data, or directing viewers to participate in a financial opportunity. The closing invitation to learn more about a viewer’s path is a general career-oriented prompt.
